content:
maria: thinking about shrinking the prefix lease metadata to reduce eviction churn across heavy multi-tenant pools. sketched a compact lease bitmap idea + probabilistic eviction window.

alex: short version?

maria: today we keep a full lease struct per prefix and a separate hot-score cache. two problems: memory overhead for millions of tiny prefixes, and eviction storms when many prefixes cross thresholds at similar times.

sam: so compaction + smoothing to avoid waves?

maria: yeah. proposal: 1) compress lease footprint to ~16 bytes using a packed struct, 2) track a per-prefix 8-bit hot_score with saturating increment on hits, 3) use a randomized eviction window per epoch to spread demotes.

rachel: can you paste the struct?

maria: sure:

```
CompactLease {
  prefix_hash: u64,        // 8B key fingerprint
  epoch_and_flags: u16,    // epoch low bits + flags
  hot_score: u8,           // 0-255 saturating counter
  owner_hint: u8           // node id hint (wraps)
} // 12 bytes packed, 16 aligned
```

alex: owner_hint fits in 8 bits? collisions/rehash risk?

maria: yes, it's only a hint to prefer same shard for reads to reduce RPCs. full ownership still resolved via lease table when necessary.

sam: eviction window details?

maria: each epoch we pick a base window W_ms (config), then each prefix samples offset = H(prefix_hash ^ epoch) % W_ms to jitter its demote time. so hot prefixes demote later, cold earlier, and storms get spread. also use probabilistic demote: at demote time, demote with p = f(hot_score) (lower score => higher p).

rachel: nice. what about read-after-write and correctness? if we demote a prefix while an inflight writer assumes residency?

maria: good point. we treat demote as a hint: demote marks lease as "candidate" and starts a short grace TTL (e.g., 100ms). any in-flight pin operations bump hot_score and cancel demote. demote commit uses CAS on epoch_and_flags to avoid races.

alex: CAS is fine but adds latency on hot paths if we check it synchronously. can we make the cancel async?

maria: cancels are allowed async; but to guarantee no lost writes we keep short grace and have pin operations return a boolean indicating they observed candidate-demote; callers can retry or force re-pin. we should only expose this to internal runtime code, not customers.

ops-bot: deploy-check: ensure rollout flag and metrics.

maria: rollout plan: feature-flag behind `compact-lease-v1`. metric gates: demote_rate, reinstates_after_demote, demo_latency, eviction_storm_count. canary on 5% of Dedicated first.

sam: what about storage migration? converting existing lease table to compact form?

maria: migration options: a) dual-representation in-memory for a few minutes while background compactor sweeps, b) online on-first-touch convert when prefix is loaded, c) cold-snapshot rewrite at maintenance window. prefer (b) to avoid big pauses.

rachel: nuance: offline snapshot loses transient pins. fine. we should add a safety net: if epoch mismatch during convert, fall back to full lease lookup.

alex: are we losing any signals needed for eviction fairness (e.g., per-tenant weight)?

maria: we can store a tenant_id fingerprint in a separate small table keyed by prefix_hash -> tenant_bucket (2 bits) to bias p in probabilistic demote. keeps CompactLease small.

sam: sounds workable. do you have proposed config defaults?

maria: initial defaults:
```
compact_lease_enabled = true
evict_window_ms = 1000
demote_grace_ms = 100
hot_threshold = 64
prob_decay = 0.9
```

rachel: testing checklist?

maria: unit tests for CAS paths, chaos test with concurrent pins+demotes, loadbench with synthetic hotset, canary telemetry dashboard; add synthetic bug-injector to force epoch skew.

alex: one last concern: how does this interact with multi-tenant KV sharing? if two tenants use same prefix namespace on shared hardware, owner_hint can mislead.

maria: owner_hint only helps locality; we still verify owner via lease table. for shared pools we will set owner_hint_disable=true by default.

ops-bot: added checklist to #eng-runtime-ops:compact-lease (ops ticket 4521).

maria: ok action items: I’ll draft RFC with diagrams and state machine, sam + alex to prototype compact struct packer, rachel to own tests + metrics. aiming for PR next week. :rocket:

alex: ack.

sam: ack.

rachel: ack.

maria: thanks all!
